patches.why: Per-XUID offline achievement transactions and original XDBF metadata, shared across profile handoff with durable atomic replacement. Reject incompatible current metadata instead of using stale cached scores; accept every ID actually declared by the original catalog.

llvm.why: ReXGlue v0.10.0 CMakeLists.txt rejects non-Clang compilers and Clang < 18; official win-amd64 CI installs upstream LLVM. 22.1.8 was the newest stable LLVM when v0.10.0 was tagged (2026-08-21).
